name: Folding Slim Clothes Drying Rack
description:
The model is built primarily with curves and modifiers, keeping the file lightweight and easy to adjust. Tube diameters, proportions, and overall dimensions can be modified quickly thanks to the procedural setup.

The structure includes the top drying frame, parallel drying rods, X-shaped folding legs, central pivot bolt, support braces, connectors, and rubber feet.

A functional rig is included. The folding mechanism is fully controllable via the armature, allowing the rack to be opened and closed easily for animation or posing.

Clean topology, optimized for visualization and product renders. Suitable for interior scenes, household environments, and realistic everyday setups.

Rigged version. Materials included.
